items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: And I waited with uh, Ted O'Harris.

ctx.x: And uh, Ambrose, an uncle to uh, Lawrence Tucker, played the trombone. Then I waited a while with uh, Amos Riley, up in uh, up there in uh, 12th Ward. And I waited with uh, Ted O'Harris. Well a lot of the, the old had been gone a long time.
You said O'Harris, I didn't play the trumpet player.
He's been on a lot of, all of them been gone.
